entities.summary: Chatchai Sasakul is a Thai former professional Muay Thai fighter and boxer. He competed in the 1988 Seoul Olympic Games before going on to hold the WBC Flyweight title from May 1997 to December 1998. Aside from being a professional boxer, he is also a practitioner in snooker.
